info.title: Fenwira API
info.description: Generated from the NestJS routes and @fenwira/contracts Zod schemas (docs/API_SPEC.md). Responses use the `{ data, page?, meta? }` envelope; errors use the error envelope.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Must equal the fw_csrf cookie (double submit).

apiKey.description: A tenant API key (docs/API_KEYS.md): `Authorization: Bearer fw_<prefix>_<secret>`. Only routes marked `x-public` accept it; every other route answers 404.
